title: Technology in your life
instructionsHu: A vizsgáztató arról kérdez, milyen technikai eszközöket használsz, és mit gondolsz a tudományról. Válaszolj több mondatban, és mondj példákat a saját életedből.

questions.q: What electronic devices do you use every day?
followUps: Which one could you not live without?

questions.q: What do you mostly use your phone for?
How many hours a day do you spend in front of a screen?
Do you use computers or tablets at school? What for?
How do your grandparents use technology? Do you help them?
Do you like science subjects at school, for example physics or biology?
Do you watch science programmes or videos? What was the last one about?
What do you do to keep your personal information safe online?
What do you think will be the most important invention of the next twenty years?

usefulPhrases.en: I use my phone for almost everything.
I spend about four hours a day online.
usefulPhrases.hu: Naponta kb. négy órát töltök az interneten.
Soha nem adom meg senkinek a jelszavamat.
